conventions_note: All statuses in this edition are "observing" (collected but not judged; no criterion has been defined). "not_yet_measured" means missing, not zero.

latest.source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (data published by the European TSOs under Regulation (EU) No 543/2013)
